    Finite normalization of an associative family #

    Theorem 7.7 (thm:finite-family-normalization, characteristic-two-construction.tex). Let Λ be graded with Λ₀ = S spanned by vertex idempotents, μ_i normalized S-relative two-cocycles of positive degrees whose classes span HH²(Λ)_{>0}, and m_t = m + Σ t_i μ_i associative. Then every positive filtered deformation of Λ is isomorphic to a fibre m_λ, by a filtered map with identity leading terms fixing the lifted vertex idempotents.

    "By Lemma 6.4, after lifting the vertex idempotents and splitting the filtration, the deformation has multiplication ⋆ on the vector space Λ […] Suppose it agrees with m_λ in degrees less than q […] Let φ_q be the degree-q part of ⋆ - m_λ. […] The remaining equation is dφ_q = 0. The spanning assumption therefore gives scalars c_i and a normalized one-cochain f_q of degree q such that φ_q = Σ_{q_i = q} c_iμ_i + df_q. Assign λ_i = c_i for q_i = q […] Pull ⋆ back by 1 - f_q."

    Here the stage invariant is Stage (the error ⋆_g - m_λ raises degree by q); degPart_cocycle is dφ_q = 0, stage_succ the change of variables. The associativity of m_t over k[t] is used only through its specializations (FamilyHyp.assoc).
